authorized_scope: One authoritative loading, unloading, and unknown role contract using the existing TicketRole enum
Immutable template versions with anchors, recognition regions, reference hashes, masks, alignment evidence, and canonical fingerprints
Draft, development_tested, and shadow lifecycle only, including append-only publication evidence and atomic shadow rollback
Low-cost role evidence from existing OCR text lines, fixed text, normalized geometry, and all shadow template families
Four-orientation matching that returns unknown for weak, ambiguous, conflicting, unknown-layout, and non-ticket evidence
A developer-protected template workbench under the System area with pointer and keyboard box editing

forbidden_scope: Real Chengfeng access, login, browser automation, credentials, production images, platform writes, or cloud OCR
Legacy project scripts, databases, runtimes, browser profiles, processes, ports, caches, or data mutation
Using platform weight, upload slot, file name, or expected role to select a template or rank role evidence
Changing the accepted OCR v1 worker protocol or rebuilding the Loop 6 runtime composition
Adding a second TicketRole, TicketSlot, scheduler, or frontend business state machine
Publishing an active or operational template, production switch, or Loop 8 audit integration
Treating synthetic fixtures, historical OCR samples, or old-program output as locked-set truth
Tuning code, templates, thresholds, mappings, rules, or labels after observing the locked acceptance set
assumptions: Existing OCR text lines and normalized boxes are sufficient to test the first low-cost role/template hypothesis without another full OCR pass.
The current exact OCR layout fingerprint is provenance only and is not a reusable layout similarity score.
The synthetic fixture proves contracts, safe unknown behavior, lifecycle, and metric calculation; it cannot prove real ticket accuracy.
A template shadow-pointer change affects only future jobs because running jobs freeze their template-set fingerprint.
The independent locked set is not yet available and its release gate must remain pending until the user supplies human-confirmed unseen samples.
